scenes.name: Gull Harbor
scenes.blurb: A winter storm scattered the harbor's landmarks across the bay.

scenes.name: Windmill Meadows
scenes.blurb: Harvest week, and a summer gale has carried half the farm away.

scenes.name: Snowpeak Station
scenes.blurb: One long blizzard, and the village's favourite sights have vanished under the snow.

scenes.name: Lantern Market
scenes.blurb: The night market opens at dusk, and nothing is where it should be.

scenes.name: Crater Camp
scenes.blurb: A solar flare scrambled the outpost. Put it back together before Earthrise.

scenes.name: Dino Valley
scenes.blurb: The dinosaurs wandered off the map. Coax them back into the valley.

scenes.name: Coral Reef
scenes.blurb: A storm surge stirred up the reef. Settle everything back on the sand.

scenes.name: Castle Hill
scenes.blurb: The dragon sneezed. Rebuild the hill before it wakes up.

scenes.name: Mirage Oasis
scenes.blurb: Was the oasis ever real? Put it back together and find out.

scenes.name: Cloud Isles
scenes.blurb: High above the clouds, the islands have lost their landmarks.
